'''June 2001 Westerville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Comic Town, Westerville, Ohio on 30 June 2001. [[Justin Danenberg]] won it. It is known from Brian Sykes's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2555">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-01-columbus-oh-origins-warm-up-6-30-01d2555/ columbus-oh-origins-warm-up-6-30-01], DeckTech (Brian "Armus" Sykes, 1 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-01-columbus-oh-origins-warm-up-6-30-01d2555/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 30 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Comic Town, Westerville, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Justin Danenberg]]
